# Documentation templates

Copy and adapt these blank formats when the project has real content. They are examples, not source evidence or approved project rules.

- [source-manifest.md](source-manifest.md) — provenance and storage record for supplied material.
- [requirement.md](requirement.md) — one stable, traceable obligation.
- [epic.md](epic.md) — a capability boundary and its dependencies.
- [requirement-allocation.md](requirement-allocation.md) — requirement-to-source, epic, feature, and verification mapping.
- [change-log.md](change-log.md) — canonical effect of incorporated requests.
